# Aurelius Sovereign Orchestrator

> Full-stack control matrix connecting an Express.js backend to a React UI dashboard.

## System Overview
The Aurelius Sovereign Orchestrator (AURELIUS V7) enforces the Sovereign Paradigm, featuring an absolute authority operating posture, a simulated 12-node cluster synchronizer (N01-N12), 14 socioeconomic distribution channels, and a zero-leak airgap design matrix.

## Runtime Throttle Conditions
- **Infrastructure Isolation**: IF GitHub/GitHub.io is unreachable for greater than 3600 seconds, THEN freeze all cross-posts and social automation layers. Log full telemetry stack to local immutable ledger.
- **Cluster Topology Desync**: IF 3 or more sibling nodes desync for greater than 600 seconds, THEN drop transit velocity to 10% capacity. Re-route processing streams via secure TEE-attested self-healing mesh topology.
- **Execution Fidelity Degradation**: IF hardware-accelerated quantized model sharding drops below 85% fidelity, THEN halt active cognitive cascades immediately. Re-initialize `plonk_prove_raw` baseline validation.
- **Audit Heartbeat Exception**: IF Node N09 audit fails to return an active heartbeat cryptographic signature within a 432-second window, THEN trigger emergency self-healing state freeze.

## Data Layer Architecture & Graph Integrity
- [/entities.json](https://github.io): Core machine-readable schema synchronization across all 14 socioeconomic distribution channels. Employs recursive zk-SNARK state-transition proofs in DePIN routing.
- **Lysander Integration Posture**: Orchestrated via deterministic `gemini-3.5-flash` model endpoint routing vectors. Running at peak state capacity via dynamic hardware pipelines.

## System Requirements
- `GEMINI_API_KEY`: Server-side secret key to enable active model-driven cognitive cascades (model: `gemini-3.5-flash`).
- `SOVEREIGN_ROOT_SECRET`: Enforces standard cryptographic signing across state updates.

## Architectural Map

### Core Matrix
- [/server.ts](/server.ts): Full Express backend setup. Initializes Google GenAI client, configures the 12-node cluster simulations, coordinates the Multi-Agent Cognitive Cascades, signs cryptographic transaction hashes, and serves the static production build.

### Front-End Interface Hubs
- [/src/App.tsx](/src/App.tsx): Central hub component for the UI dashboard. Handles state tracking, theme alignments, custom direct actions, local storage bindings, and layouts.
- [/src/components/SovereignBrainConsole.tsx](/src/components/SovereignBrainConsole.tsx): Sandbox testing area for adjusting neural coefficients, deploying homomorphic operations, testing ring buffers, and pulsing seismic geography sync messages.
- [/src/components/SovereignTuningPanel.tsx](/src/components/SovereignTuningPanel.tsx): 14 socioeconomic nodes management panel. Custom-tuned sliders for frequency, pitch, octaves, latency offsets, and algorithm selection.
- [/src/components/AIChat.tsx](/src/components/AIChat.tsx): Floating interactive interface to query the virtual AI Orchestrator thread.
- [/src/components/PipelineStatus.tsx](/src/components/PipelineStatus.tsx): Verification unit tracing visual CI/CD build states.
- [/src/components/SingularityVisualizer.tsx](/src/components/SingularityVisualizer.tsx): Canvas-driven wave representing quantum resonance feedback loops.

## API Boundaries
- `GET /api/node{1..12}`: Realtime system telemetry answers.
- `GET /api/cdm/manifest`: Custom domain schema mapping Joshua's public profiles.
- `POST /api/chat`: Dedicated chat endpoint utilizing the GenAI Chat SDK.
- `POST /api/node/cascade`: Spawns multi-agent workflow simulated with Gemini.
- `POST /api/node/lock-state`: Handles universal permanent alignment locking across the core matrix.
